messages.content: who were critics of nicolaus copernicus Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content:
Who opposed the heliocentric model? Many religious leaders rejected it.

The Catholic Church initially condemned his ideas. Why did they do so? It challenged biblical literalism.

Some astronomers also criticized him. They preferred the Ptolemaic system. Was Copernicus wrong? No, he was right.

His work sparked debate for centuries. How significant was this shift? It was revolutionary.
